title: Rabbi Dosi the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:8: Rabbi Chizkiyah, Rabbi Dostai, Rabbi Abba bar Zemina — and they attribute it in the name of Rabbi Dosi the Elder (in Nedarim, end of chapter 10, the reading is Rabbi Dostai the Elder) — thus he wrote (Rabbi Yehudah Nesia, concerning Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba): “Behold, we have sent you a great man,” etc.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:8 reads Dostai the Elder where Hyman gives Dosi the Elder. Hyman also reports Dostai the Elder for the end of Nedarim chapter 10.
